 Shopping for 2027 health coverage? UCHealth details its in-network Medicare Advantage and Connect for Health Colorado plans.
 By: Kelli Christensen 
 7 hours ago 
 Are you looking for Medicare or Connect for Health plans that include UCHealth facilities and providers? Learn more about how to find the right plans. Photo: Getty Images. 
 UCHealth will be in-network with a wide range of Medicare Advantage and Connect for Health Colorado Marketplace plans in 2027.
 Some plans include all UCHealth hospitals and medical group providers. Others include only select locations. Before enrolling, patients should check that their preferred UCHealth locations and providers are included in their specific plan.
 Important Medicare dates for 2027 
 Medicare Annual Open Enrollment | Oct. 15 – Dec. 7, 2026: People with Medicare can join, change or leave a Medicare Advantage plan or return to Original Medicare. Changes take effect Jan. 1, 2027.
 Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment | Jan. 1 – March 31, 2027: People already enrolled in Medicare Advantage can make one change to another Medicare Advantage plan or return to Original Medicare. Changes generally take effect the first day of the month after the plan receives the request.
 Traditional Medicare 
 UCHealth continues to accept traditional Medicare, including patients who have Medicare Supplement (Medigap) insurance, subject to Medicare coverage requirements.
 UCHealth is an in-network provider with the following Medicare Advantage plans: 
 All UCHealth hospitals, ancillary facilities, and UCHealth Medical Group providers will be in-network with these Medicare Advantage plans in 2027:
 Aetna Medicare Advantage
 Anthem Medicare Advantage
 Humana Medicare Advantage
 Select Health Medicare Advantage
 UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage
 Additionally, Kaiser Permanente Medicare Advantage is in-network for select UCHealth locations, including University of Colorado Hospital in metro Denver and all UCHealth locations in Colorado Springs and Pueblo.
 UCHealth is no longer an in-network provider for Cigna Medicare Advantage (also known as Healthspring Medicare Advantage) or Devoted Health Medicare Advantage plans.
 Medicare Advantage: Select UCHealth locations in-network with Kaiser 
 Kaiser Permanente Medicare Advantage includes in-network access to:
 University of Colorado Hospital 
 Estes Valley Medical Center 
 UCHealth hospitals, clinics and other services in El Paso, Pueblo and Teller counties
 Free Medicare plan comparison help 
 UCHealth has partnered with Planmatch, powered by Benefits Life, an independent Colorado-based Medicare insurance agency, to help patients understand their Medicare coverage options .
 Licensed insurance agents can help patients find Medicare plans accepted by their preferred UCHealth providers, compare premiums, copayments and prescription drug costs and choose coverage that meets their needs and budget.
 This service is free and optional. There is no obligation to enroll. Visit planmatch.com/uchealth or call 1.800.597.1001 (TTY 711) to speak with a licensed insurance agent.
 Connect for Health Colorado open enrollment dates 
 Open Enrollment | Nov. 1, 2026 – Jan.y 15, 2027: Enroll by Dec. 15, 2026, for coverage beginning Jan. 1, 2027. Enroll from Dec. 16, 2026, through Jan. 15, 2027, for coverage beginning Feb. 1, 2027.
 Important change for Cigna members in 2027 
 Cigna will no longer offer individual and family medical insurance plans, currently sold under the Cigna Connect name, beginning Jan. 1, 2027. Patients enrolled in these plans will need to choose new health insurance coverage for 2027. This change does not affect employer-sponsored Cigna health insurance plans.
 Connect for Health Colorado: All UCHealth hospitals and medical group providers 
 The following plans include all UCHealth hospitals and UCHealth Medical Group providers:
 Anthem Pathway
 Select Health Value
 The Colorado Option versions of these plans are also accepted throughout UCHealth.
 Connect for Health Colorado: Select UCHealth locations in-network 
 Select plans include UCHealth hospitals, clinics and services in certain parts of Colorado. The locations covered depend on the plan. UCHealth also participates with the Colorado Option versions of these plans.
 Visit Connect for Health Colorado to compare plans, review costs and find out whether you qualify for financial help. Before enrolling, confirm with your insurance company that your preferred UCHealth hospital, clinic and providers are in-network for your specific plan.
 Denver Metro and Boulder County 
 Counties: Adams, Arapahoe, Boulder, Broomfield, Denver, Douglas and Jefferson
 Participating plans: Anthem Pathway Essentials; Colorado Access Choice.
 Hospitals: University of Colorado Hospital ; Highlands Ranch Hospital ; Broomfield Hospital ; Longs Peak Hospital. 
 Surgery centers: Cherry Creek North Surgery Center ;  Inverness Orthopedics and Spine Surgery Center ; Longs Peak Surgery Center .
 Other services: Participating UCHealth Medical Group clinics, urgent care centers, imaging, laboratory and community outpatient physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech therapy services.
 Southern Colorado 
 Counties: El Paso, Pueblo and Teller
 Participating plans: Colorado Access Choice; Kaiser KP Select.
 Hospitals: Memorial Hospital Central ; Memorial Hospital North ; Grandview Hospital ; Pikes Peak Regional Hospital ; Parkview Medical Center ; Parkview Pueblo West .
 Surgery centers: Eastview Surgery Center .
 Other services: Participating UCHealth Medical Group clinics, urgent care centers, imaging and laboratory services in Colorado Springs, Pueblo, Woodland Park and surrounding communities.
 Steamboat Springs and Routt County 
 Participating plans: Anthem Mountain Enhanced; Rocky Mountain Health Plans Rocky Mountain HMO Valley; Rocky Mountain Health Plans Monument Health HMO.
 Participating Locations: Yampa Valley Medical Center , and associated YVMC outpatient clinic locations.
 Estes Park and Estes Valley 
 Participating plans: Kaiser KP Select.
 Participating locations: Estes Valley Medical Center , and associated EVMC outpatient clinic locations.
